City of Encinitas
Amended Youth Commission Special Meeting
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 2, 2026 -
10:30 AM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.

4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.

CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE JUNE 3, 2026, YOUTH COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
Approve the June 3, 2026, Youth Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

Elect the FY 2026-2027 Chair and Vice Chair to serve one term.
8A. Youth Commission Chair and Vice Chair

FY 26-27 Youth Commission Work Plan Preparation
Review a list of potential work plan initiatives and begin work on the plan and assignment of Youth Commission representatives (maximum of four (4) commissioners per initiative).
8B. FY26-27 Youth Commission Work Plan Preparation
8C.
FY 26-27 Youth Commission Meeting Calendar
Adopt the proposed FY 2026/27 Youth Commission meeting calendar.

9A.
Department updates - Recreation Services Manager Goodsell
10.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
11.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Items added with consensus of two or more Commissioners.

13.
ADJOURNMENT
